Two-stage flow for KYA's economic / delegated-staking pipeline: Stage 1 —
point AWP rewards at the KYA deposit address (gasless via AWP relayer): 1.
Read agent EOA from awp-wallet (or --agent override). 2. (optional) GET
/v1/agents/:address/deposit-address to pick the recipient. 3. Read
AWPRegistry.nonces(agent), build SetRecipient typed-data, sign. 4. POST
signature to AWP_RELAY_BASE/api/relay/set-recipient. 5. Poll relay status
until confirmed (skippable with --no-poll). Stage 2 — tell KYA "I want N AWP
backing my agent" (only with --amount): 6. Sign KYA
